project_type: ComfyUI Python custom-node repository with a plain JavaScript /afe/ web UI and persisted batch-analysis sessions
build_system: No compile/build bundler; Python modules are loaded by ComfyUI. Workflow JSON is generated by gen_afe_main_workflow.py.
test_framework: Standalone Python CPU regression scripts, plus Playwright-driven tests/ui_e2e.py against tests/ui_mock_server.py
test_command: python3 tests/test_full_script_batch_regression.py && python3 tests/test_analysis_session.py && python3 tests/test_scene_map.py && python3 tests/test_parser_merge.py && python3 tests/test_prompt_fidelity.py && python3 tests/test_reference_dependencies.py && python3 tests/test_shot_contract.py && python3 tests/test_webui_validation.py && python3 tests/test_workflow_graph.py && python3 tests/check_graphs.py && python3 tests/ui_e2e.py
verification_instructions: Run compileall first, then the new complete-script regression and the documented analysis/session, scene/parser, prompt, reference, shot, WebUI, graph, check_graphs, and Playwright UI scripts. Run gen_afe_main_workflow.py and confirm the checked-in full and batch workflow JSON remains graph-valid and has no unintended diff. CPU/mock checks do not prove GPU visual quality.
snapshot_or_generated_files: gen_afe_main_workflow.py writes workflow_templates/afe_full_pipeline.json and workflow_templates/afe_script_pipeline.json; regenerate only for verification and inspect the diff before keeping any change.
environment_constraints: Work directly in E:\MJ\ai_film_editor_nodes on main; do not create a worktree, reset, delete, force-push, or overwrite pre-existing review/log/cache/task files. RunPod production path is /workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai_film_editor_nodes. Real Qwen model loading is not part of CPU tests.
contribution_requirements: Follow the repository AGENTS.md rules already loaded by the workflow. Keep strict source/fact validation, preserve resumable ordered batches and the complete-session gate, and make no unrelated refactor or UI protocol change.
key_patterns: screenplay_source_units.py makes each explicit shot heading plus body one contiguous unit with offsets; script_analysis_session.py persists source_block_id/unit_id ranges and atomically validates commit/recovery; server.py builds batch_context_json and gates publication; script_full_parser_node.py uses two LLM phases but must treat source catalog as authoritative; existing tests use importlib stubs for parser calls and tempfile session stores.
directory_structure: nodes/director contains parser, source-unit and session logic; webui contains server, graph builder and static client; tests contains standalone CPU, graph and UI mock tests; test_scripts contains the complete 36-shot fidelity screenplay; workflow_templates contains generated ComfyUI graphs.
